Search summaries suggest the March 2027 target applies to the underground Tavarekere–Nagawara section, not the elevated stretch. These details are unverified because I never saw a source page. Their dates and quotes are not confirmed, so I have not reported them as claims. The Deccan Herald Sampige Line (K-RIDE) tender, with bids due 9 October, appeared only in search summaries. Its publication year is not shown and the page was not opened, so I excluded it. The only in-window item is a non-official tracker's 12 Oct status. Treat it as weak evidence. As of ~12 Oct, no CMRS authorisation or official opening date for the Pink Line elevated section was found. The Hindu/BMRCL items should be re-checked by a later run.
